related_questions.question: How do I access my Quest lab results?

text_blocks.snippet: To access your Quest Diagnostics lab results, you can use the MyQuest patient portal, available at QuestDiagnostics.com/MyQuest, or through the MyQuest mobile app. You can also obtain results from your ordering doctor's office.
snippet_highlighted_words: use the MyQuest patient portal, available at QuestDiagnostics.com/MyQuest, or through the MyQuest mobile app

text_blocks.snippet: Here's how to access your results through MyQuest:

list.snippet: Create an Account: If you don't already have one, create a MyQuest account on the website or through the app. You'll need to provide some personal information and create a username and password.
Verify Your Identity: After creating an account, you'll need to verify your identity to view your results.
Log in and Access Results: Once logged in, you can access your lab results on the "Results" page.
Check for Notifications: You'll receive email notifications when your lab results are ready.
Your Doctor's Office: Your doctor can provide you with a copy of your results or send them to you directly.
QuestDiagnostics.com/MyQuest: You can access the portal through your web browser by visiting QuestDiagnostics.com/MyQuest.
MyQuest Mobile App: Download the app from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store.
